Swedish Prohibitionist Web Site Ran Survey Asking,
"What would you do if your son or daughter was a regular user of cannabis?"
"Make him share" Wasn’t One of the Choices, But I Still Don’t Think They Liked the Results

From Hassela Nordic Network
http://www.hassela.com/latest.htm
Press release, February 3, 1999

Results of last week’s survey asking ‘What would you do if your son or daughter was a regular user of cannabis?’

  • I would encourage him/her to smoke cannabis at home (334) 44%

  • I would encourage him/her to stop smoking cannabis (267) 35%

    (Marijuananews note: This poll was more silly than scientific, and they neglected to specify the age of the child. My answer would certainly be determined by his/her age.

    Nonetheless, it is interesting that almost half of the respondents on a survey at such a rabidly prohibitionist site, would simply want the kid of unknown age to stay home and smoke, and very few would want to take more drastic measures.

    One wonders if their site is just being used primarily as a resource by anti-prohibitionists. I would like to think so.

    And it is very amusing to think what their reaction must have been to the results. The poor things are surrounded by druggies! What’s prohibitionist to do?)
